exam_scheme.note: AP EAPCET (formerly AP EAMCET) is conducted as a Computer Based Test (CBT) by JNTU Kakinada on behalf of APSCHE. For the Engineering stream (MPC), the test comprises 160 multiple-choice questions (80 Mathematics, 40 Physics, 40 Chemistry) of 180 minutes duration. Each question carries 1 mark with no negative marking. Qualifying mark is 25% (40 out of 160) for General/BC candidates; no minimum qualifying mark is prescribed for SC/ST candidates. Merit ranking is prepared with 75% weightage to AP EAPCET marks and 25% weightage to Intermediate group subjects (MPC).
